build_arcface_head: build an ArcFaceClsHead classifier with num_classes and in_channels for face recognition
create_normproduct_layer: create a NormProduct linear layer that computes cosine similarity between normalized input and weight
test_arcface_forward: test the ArcFaceClsHead forward pass with features and target labels to get scaled logits
refactor_arcface_margins: refactor the ArcFaceClsHead set_margins method to update per-class margin values dynamically
review_arcface_loss: review the ArcFaceClsHead loss method that computes classification loss from features and data samples
